title: Flutter State Management: Provider, Bloc, Riverpod

scenes.line1: How do you pick state management?
scenes.say: Ever wonder which state management tool to use in Flutter? Let's break down Provider, Bloc, and Riverpod.

scenes.label: Provider
scenes.sub: Great for basic state sharing across widgets.
scenes.say: Provider is the go-to for simple apps. It's easy to set up and perfect for basic state sharing.
When your app grows, Riverpod and Bloc shine. Riverpod is flexible and test-friendly. Bloc uses streams and events for rock-solid state transitions.

scenes.code:
ChangeNotifierProvider(
  create: (_) => CounterModel())

BlocProvider(
  create: (_) => CounterBloc())
scenes.say: Here's how you set up Provider and Bloc. Both wrap your app to share state, but Bloc adds event handling.

scenes.question: Is Provider best for all apps?
scenes.right: No—Provider is simple, but for complex apps, Bloc or Riverpod scale better.
scenes.say: Don't assume Provider fits every project. For complex apps, Bloc or Riverpod are usually a better choice.
